## Progress

- [Pic0RankOneTranslatedCover.lean](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/Pic0RankOneTranslatedCover.lean:154): landed the lambda-tied positive-twist/drop result with explicit base-class, `h0 = 1`, `H1 = 0`, and an immediate `IsSplitWitness` consumer (`ead22d32ee`).
- [Pic0SepClosedCover.lean](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/Pic0SepClosedCover.lean:35): added section/base-change residue-degree-one bridges (`0abfccbdfb`).
- [Pic0SepClosedCover.lean](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/Pic0SepClosedCover.lean:103): added the explicit base-changed rational-point image, separably-closed density theorem, and residue consumer; integrated in `15919005f8`.
- Both owned files compile narrowly with `lake env lean`; all audited declarations use only `propext`, `Classical.choice`, and `Quot.sound`. No `sorry`, `axiom`, elevated heartbeat, or recursion-budget declarations were introduced.
- Roadmap/task state is durably recorded as `blocked`; I-1927 contains the handoff and ownership acknowledgment. Metadata checkpoints: `a37416bbfd`, `163870d571`, `8e9298bb3d`, `bac854447a`.

## Issues

- No constructor currently turns divisor `h0 = 1`/`H1 = 0` data into the arbitrary-affine, lambda-tied `PicRankOneLocalPresentation` required by `PicRankOneOpen`.
- No general constructor supplies `SepClosedTranslatedDropData` for every extension and input class; `baseSubtraction`, the closed-point/non-generic proof, and the full presentation family remain explicit.
- A full project build was not run because parallel integration owns the protected Phase-3/4 files; no narrow check failed.
- Final shared-index measurement at `HEAD 329825e4a5`: 5 staged paths, 7 insertions and 56 deletions, no `index.lock`. The paths include stale inverse metadata plus concurrent `DivRankOneOpen.lean`/`DivSchemeRedesignRankOneChart.lean` changes; the shared index was left untouched.

## Why I stopped

The Phase-5 route is partly advanced but not complete. Closing `PicRankOneOpen` without the missing family-level producer would violate the review’s anti-vacuity rule and the lane ownership protections.

## Next

The recovery/integration lane must provide the arbitrary-affine presentation/gluing producer and instantiate the per-`K`, per-`lambda` data package, then consume the landed translated-drop and density/residue APIs.

The finalization hook reports post-commit durable changes. I’m re-auditing the current ledger and worktree now, separating this lane’s authored paths from the active openness lane before committing anything.

- [Pic0RankOneTranslatedCover.lean](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/Pic0RankOneTranslatedCover.lean:154) contains the lambda-tied positive-twist/drop result with explicit base-class, `h0 = 1`, `H1 = 0`, and an `IsSplitWitness` consumer (`ead22d32ee`).

The requested universal translated-open cover is not complete. Closing it without the missing presentation producer would violate the anti-vacuity and ownership constraints.
